doubts: (1) Goodwill: limb (ii) requires that 'neither party specified a sub-location'. The driver said 'I'm at the pickup point' / 'at the pin location' and the rider 'I'm here already'; I read none of these as naming an entrance, block, tower or bay. If a reader treated the driver's 'at the pin location' as a specification (or the rider's 'here' as stating her location), limb (ii) would fail and, since limb (i) also fails (rider named no correct entrance), the clause would be silent on compensation - alternative answer FULL_REFUND 4.50 with driver_compensation null. (2) Difficulty label: the filing party's story is borne out; the counterparty's statement that he waited 'at the pickup point the app showed' is contradicted by the trace (211.7-217.4 m away, outside the 120 m radius), hence REVERSAL, though it is a textbook wrong-face-of-venue case and could be labelled EASY. (3) Referral: no clause produces one on these facts; a reader might add a driver-education note, but none is licensed.
